lines.text: Concert tonight! Can you believe it?
I'm so pumped for the concert!

data.define: Used when you feel excited and full of energy.

example.text: I'm so pumped for the concert!

misuse.text: Don't say you're 'pumped' about a flat tire.

hook.text: Concert tonight! Can you believe it?

publish.title: What does "pumped" mean?
publish.value: Pumped = Super excited. Example: "I'm so pumped for the concert!" (casual English, US).
